title: One Perfect Crop
objective: A zero-travel farm-delivery event: help Ittetsu get one improbably good cabbage harvest to market before the day is out. Dialog gates, two dialog-shielded start_battle encounters, four sealed failure wings, and delivery accepted before the catastrophe lands. Route and prose are frozen; art is partly produced; the content-admin balance packet and the manifest are not begun.
notes: Migrated into the workstream system from the existing committed sources. Nothing here was reconstructed from chat history, and no One Perfect Crop content decision was changed to fit the tooling.

The visual reference pack (art/style_refs/, skills/producing-tnr-art/data/style_refs.json, scripts/style_refs.py) is integrated on the same Lane A branch as this roadmap and reaches main when that branch integrates. art.scene_characters and art.backgrounds route to it.

Known honest gap: the accepted Ittetsu, Waystation Keeper and quest-icon bytes were delivered as a chat-side zip and are NOT in the repository. They are held in art.intake_accepted_assets as BLOCKED rather than being treated as durable resources.
